handoff: review#1: one blocking finding. test:integration was red in the review run (371/1): records F36 'story stays in status…' got an empty story list at records.test.ts:158. It passes 3/3 alone, so it is a parallel-only failure that AC8 requires fixed at its cause. unit, typecheck and e2e are green. Minor: AC6 golden adds 9 (pre-existing, state it in the PR); AC5 has no automated guard run; the test:fast edit, the 7th e2e file and the path-depth assertion changes go in the PR; AGENTS/CI are stale until slice 06; tier selection is emulated, not bun's; golden harvestCommand throws for a non-tier file. Nits: the 'in*' glob gap, the shadowed fakeHerdr, the B16 import regex.

findings.title: Parallel-only failure in integration: records F36 sees an empty story list
findings.detail:
In the review's run, `bun run test:integration` failed: `(fail) records: … > F36: the story stays in status after its worktree is gone; local main is stale`, `expect(keys).toContain("gh-5")`, received [] (records.test.ts:158), 371 pass / 1 fail, 107 s. `bun test --config=bunfig.integration.toml --timeout=20000 packages/cli/test/integration/records.test.ts` passes 3/3 serially. AC8: 'the cause of any parallel-only failure is fixed, not retried around, and named in the handoff'. The implement handoff saw 3 green runs, so the failure is intermittent under load or parallelism. Likely suspects: `norn story list` depends on durable status read from the machine dir or a cache shared across parallel processes (HOME/~/.norn), or on timing (wall-clock vs the harness clock).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Reproduce with repeated `bun run test:integration` runs, or with records.test.ts run alongside other files. Find the shared state or timing dependency and fix it (for example an isolated NORN home per harness, or no wall-clock in that path). Name the cause in the handoff.

findings.title: `bun run golden` adds 9 cases, so AC6 is not met as written
findings.detail:
AC6/B18: '`bun run golden` adds no case'. The handoff says it adds 9, and the same 9 are added on the pre-slice HEAD, which makes this a pre-existing gap in the corpus, not a regression. The PR must state this; the spec example should be amended or a follow-up filed.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Say so in the PR and handoff; let the person decide whether to amend B18 or add the cases separately.

findings.title: AC5 (verifier: test) has no automated test of the unit guard over packages/cli/test/unit
findings.detail:
No check or test runs `bun test --preload <guard> packages/cli/test/unit`. The only evidence is the handoff's '114 pass'. The splits keep every test (segment 4=2+2, tidy-herdr 8=4+4).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Accept on handoff evidence until slice 07 turns the guard on, or add the run as a check.

findings.title: Changes that must be named in the PR: test:fast edited, 7th e2e file, assertions changed by path depth
findings.detail:
package.json:10 test:fast changed, although the slice says it stays until slice 06. The change is justified: a CLI --path-ignore-patterns replaces the bunfig ones. `test:cli` now silently runs only cli unit. pinned-outputs is a 7th e2e file, which D4 'pin effects' allows but D10 counts six. Its expected folders/REPO_ROOT depth changed, and so did the housekeeping plugin-hint path depth (the Notes say a changed assertion is a PR finding).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: List these in the PR; revisit D10's shard count in slice 06.

findings.title: Docs and CI point at the old layout; CI's `bun test` no longer runs cli integration/e2e
findings.detail:
AGENTS.md:8-11,20,22,24 still name packages/cli/test/transcript.ts, e2e.test.ts, transcripts/, observe-snapshot(s) and the `NORN_TRANSCRIPT_UPDATE=1 bun test <file>` recipe. ci.yml:32 and release.yml run only `bun test`, which now ignores both tiers. These belong to slice 06, but the story branch must not reach main before it does.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Note in the handoff that slice 06 must land before the story merges.

findings.title: The tier selection rule checks against its own model of bun
findings.detail:
tierSelection re-implements bun's root and ignore matching with Bun.Glob. It assumes repo-relative ignore matching and lists only *.test.ts. If bun differs, the rule stays green while the tier selects wrongly. The rule never asks bun.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optionally add one check that compares with what bun actually selects (e.g. a dry listing), or state the assumption in the PR.

findings.title: A named file outside both tiers throws inside Promise.all
findings.detail:
harvestCommand throws for a file in neither tier. The throw escapes inside Promise.all, so the temp `raw` dir is left behind and a stack trace prints instead of the `failed` report.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Validate the named files before mkdtemp, or catch the throw and report the file as failed.

findings.title: The ignore glob {[!i]*,i[!n]*} would admit any test folder starting with 'in' (e.g. inbox/)
findings.detail:
The B5 rule catches this only once such a folder exists. The pattern does not say 'not integration'.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Accept, or tighten the pattern if bun's glob allows it.

findings.title: A local fakeHerdr shadows test/support/fake-herdr.ts's fakeHerdr with a different shape
findings.detail:
Same name, different signature; easy to import the wrong one.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Rename the local helper.

findings.title: The B16 import rule misses side-effect and transitive imports, and matches any transcript.ts
findings.detail:
`import "./transcript.ts"` and imports through another support helper go unseen. src/agent-hooks/transcript.ts would be a false positive.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Match on the resolved test/support paths.
